基于代码分析，我发现了以下几个问题和冗余：

1. 日历面板重复代码：
- 开始日期和结束日期的日历面板代码在 `task-edit.wxml` 中几乎完全相同，只是变量名和标题不同
- 相关的样式代码在 `task-edit.wxss` 中也有大量重复

2. 废弃的代码：
- 根据 `README.md` 中的记录，已经删除了 `date-picker`、`calendar-picker` 等冗余组件，但相关的引用和样式可能还存在
- 在 `.specstory/history` 目录下有多处提到已废弃的 `calendar` 组件的记录

3. 冗余的状态管理：
- `task-edit.js` 中维护了大量的日历相关状态：
  - `startCalendarDays` 和 `endCalendarDays` 数组
  - `startYearMonth` 和 `endYearMonth` 
  - `startYearMonthText` 和 `endYearMonthText`
  - `startYearText`、`startMonthText`、`endYearText`、`endMonthText`

4. 重复的日历生成逻辑：
- `generateCalendarDays` 函数被多次调用，逻辑相似
- 日期处理相关的辅助函数有重复代码

建议的清理方案：

1. 组件化重构：

主要从以下几个方面进行优化：

1. 首先将日历面板抽取为独立组件：

```javascript:components/date-panel/date-panel.js
Component({
  properties: {
    type: {
      type: String,
      value: 'start'  // 'start' 或 'end'
    },
    visible: {
      type: Boolean,
      value: false
    },
    selectedDate: String,
    minDate: String,
    maxDate: String
  },

  data: {
    calendarDays: [],
    yearMonth: '',
    yearText: '',
    monthText: ''
  },

  methods: {
    // 生成日历数据
    generateCalendarDays(customYear, customMonth) {
      console.log(`[DatePanel] 生成${this.properties.type}日历数据开始`);
      
      const yearMonthData = this.getYearMonthData(customYear, customMonth);
      const { year, month } = yearMonthData;
      
      // 更新年月显示
      this.updateYearMonthDisplay(year, month);
      
      // 生成日历数据
      const days = this.generateMonthDays(year, month);
      
      this.setData({ calendarDays: days });
      
      console.log(`[DatePanel] 生成${this.properties.type}日历数据完成，共${days.length}天`);
    },

    // 选择日期
    selectDate(e) {
      const date = e.currentTarget.dataset.date;
      this.triggerEvent('dateselect', { date });
    },

    // 切换月份
    changeMonth(e) {
      const action = e.currentTarget.dataset.action;
      // ... 月份切换逻辑
    },

    // 切换年份
    changeYear(e) {
      const action = e.currentTarget.dataset.action;
      // ... 年份切换逻辑
    }
  }
});
```

2. 对应的模板文件：

```html:components/date-panel/date-panel.wxml
<view class="calendar-container {{visible ? 'expanded' : ''}}" catchtouchmove="preventTouchMove">
  <view class="calendar-panel" catchtap="preventClose">
    <view class="calendar-header">
      <!-- 左侧：年月选择区域 -->
      <view class="header-year-month">
        <view class="nav-btn month-nav" 
              bindtap="changeMonth" 
              data-action="prev" 
              bindlongpress="changeYear" 
              data-action="prev">
          <text class="nav-icon">〈</text>
        </view>
        <picker mode="date" fields="month" value="{{yearMonth}}" bindchange="onYearMonthChange">
          <view class="header-year-month-text">
            <view class="year-text">{{yearText}}</view>
            <view class="month-text">{{monthText}}</view>
          </view>
        </picker>
        <view class="nav-btn month-nav" 
              bindtap="changeMonth" 
              data-action="next" 
              bindlongpress="changeYear" 
              data-action="next">
          <text class="nav-icon">〉</text>
        </view>
      </view>
      
      <!-- 中间：标题 -->
      <text class="calendar-title">选择{{type === 'start' ? '开始' : '结束'}}日期</text>
      
      <!-- 右侧：完成按钮 -->
      <view class="calendar-close" bindtap="onClose">完成</view>
    </view>
    
    <view class="weekdays">
      <view class="weekday" wx:for="{{['一','二','三','四','五','六','日']}}" wx:key="*this">
        {{item}}
      </view>
    </view>
    
    <view class="calendar-days">
      <view wx:for="{{calendarDays}}" 
            wx:key="date" 
            class="calendar-day {{item.currentMonth ? 'current-month' : 'other-month'}} {{item.date === selectedDate ? 'selected' : ''}} {{item.isToday ? 'today' : ''}} {{item.isPast ? 'past' : ''}}"
            bindtap="selectDate"
            data-date="{{item.date}}">
        {{item.day}}
      </view>
    </view>
  </view>
</view>
```

3. 修改任务编辑页面，使用新组件：

```html:pages/task-edit/task-edit.wxml
<!-- 日历遮罩层 -->
<view class="calendar-mask {{startDatePanel || endDatePanel || repeatPanel || reminderPanel ? 'visible' : ''}}" 
      bindtap="closeAllPanels" 
      catchtouchmove="preventTouchMove">
</view>

<!-- 使用日期面板组件 -->
<date-panel type="start"
           visible="{{startDatePanel}}"
           selected-date="{{newTask.startDate}}"
           bind:dateselect="onStartDateSelect"
           bind:close="closeAllPanels" />

<date-panel type="end"
           visible="{{endDatePanel}}"
           selected-date="{{newTask.endDate}}"
           min-date="{{newTask.startDate}}"
           bind:dateselect="onEndDateSelect"
           bind:close="closeAllPanels" />
```

4. 修改任务编辑页面的 JS 代码：

```javascript:pages/task-edit/task-edit.js
Page({
  data: {
    // 移除重复的日历数据
    // 删除: startCalendarDays, endCalendarDays
    // 删除: startYearMonth, endYearMonth 等
    
    startDatePanel: false,
    endDatePanel: false
  },

  // 开始日期选择处理
  onStartDateSelect(e) {
    const date = e.detail.date;
    console.log('[TaskEdit] 选择开始日期:', date);
    
    this.setData({
      'newTask.startDate': date,
      startDatePanel: false
    });

    // 如果结束日期早于开始日期，自动调整
    if (this.data.newTask.endDate < date) {
      this.setData({
        'newTask.endDate': date
      });
    }
  },

  // 结束日期选择处理
  onEndDateSelect(e) {
    const date = e.detail.date;
    console.log('[TaskEdit] 选择结束日期:', date);
    
    if (!this.isValidEndDate(this.data.newTask.startDate, date)) {
      wx.showToast({
        title: '结束日期不能早于开始日期',
        icon: 'none',
        duration: 2000
      });
      return;
    }

    this.setData({
      'newTask.endDate': date,
      endDatePanel: false
    });
  }
});
```

5. 将日期处理相关的工具函数移到独立文件：

```javascript:utils/dateUtils.js
const dateUtils = {
  /**
   * 生成月份天数数据
   */
  generateMonthDays(year, month) {
    console.log('[DateUtils] 生成月份数据:', year, month + 1);
    
    const days = [];
    const today = new Date();
    const todayYear = today.getFullYear();
    const todayMonth = today.getMonth();
    const todayDate = today.getDate();
    const todayTimestamp = today.getTime();

    // 获取当月的第一天和最后一天
    const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1);
    const lastDay = new Date(year, month + 1, 0);
    
    // 添加上月日期
    this.addPrevMonthDays(days, firstDay, todayYear, todayMonth, todayDate, todayTimestamp);
    
    // 添加当月日期
    this.addCurrentMonthDays(days, year, month, lastDay.getDate(), todayYear, todayMonth, todayDate, todayTimestamp);
    
    // 添加下月日期
    this.addNextMonthDays(days, year, month, todayYear, todayMonth, todayDate, todayTimestamp);
    
    return days;
  },

  /**
   * 格式化年月显示
   */
  formatYearMonth(year, month) {
    return {
      yearMonth: `${year}-${String(month + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`,
      yearText: `${year}年`,
      monthText: `${month + 1}月`
    };
  }
};

module.exports = dateUtils;
```

这样重构后的优点：

1. 代码复用性提高：
   - 日历面板逻辑被封装为独立组件
   - 日期处理工具函数统一管理

2. 状态管理简化：
   - 移除了重复的状态数据
   - 组件内部管理自己的状态

3. 日志更清晰：
   - 每个模块都有自己的日志前缀
   - 关键操作都有日志记录

4. 维护性提升：
   - 功能模块化，职责清晰
   - 减少了重复代码
   - 方便后续扩展和修改

5. 性能优化：
   - 组件化后可以更好地利用微信小程序的性能优化机制
   - 减少了不必要的数据更新

需要注意的是，这个重构方案遵循了最小修改原则，主要聚焦于去除重复代码。如果你觉得某个部分需要更详细的说明，我可以进一步展开。

+     generateCalendarDays(customYear, customMonth) {
+       console.log(`[DatePanel] 生成${this.properties.type}日历数据开始`);
+       
+       const yearMonthData = this.getYearMonthData(customYear, customMonth);
+       const { year, month } = yearMonthData;
+       
+       // 更新年月显示
+       this.updateYearMonthDisplay(year, month);
+       
+       // 生成日历数据
+       const days = this.generateMonthDays(year, month);
+       
+       this.setData({ calendarDays: days });
+       
+       console.log(`[DatePanel] 生成${this.properties.type}日历数据完成，共${days.length}天`);
+     },
+ 
+     // 选择日期
+     selectDate(e) {
+       const date = e.currentTarget.dataset.date;
+       this.triggerEvent('dateselect', { date });
+     },
+ 
+     // 切换月份
+     changeMonth(e) {
+       const action = e.currentTarget.dataset.action;
+       let yearMonth = this.data.yearMonth;
+       let [year, month] = yearMonth.split('-').map(Number);
+       
+       if (action === 'prev') {
+         month--;
+         if (month === 0) {
+           month = 12;
+           year--;
+         }
+       } else {
+         month++;
+         if (month === 13) {
+           month = 1;
+           year++;
+         }
+       }
+       
+       this.generateCalendarDays(year, month - 1);
+     },
+ 
+     // 切换年份
+     changeYear(e) {
+       const action = e.currentTarget.dataset.action;
+       let yearMonth = this.data.yearMonth;
+       let [year, month] = yearMonth.split('-').map(Number);
+       
+       if (action === 'prev') {
+         year--;
+       } else {
+         year++;
+       }
+       
+       this.generateCalendarDays(year, month - 1);
+     },
+ 
+     // 获取年月数据
+     getYearMonthData(customYear, customMonth) {
+       let year, month;
+       if (customYear !== undefined && customMonth !== undefined) {
+         year = customYear;
+         month = customMonth;
+       } else {
+         const today = new Date();
+         const selectedDate = this.properties.selectedDate ? new Date(this.properties.selectedDate) : today;
+         year = selectedDate.getFullYear();
+         month = selectedDate.getMonth();
+       }
+       return { year, month };
+     },
+ 
+     // 更新年月显示
+     updateYearMonthDisplay(year, month) {
+       const yearMonthStr = `${year}-${String(month + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
+       const yearText = `${year}年`;
+       const monthText = `${month + 1}月`;
+       
+       this.setData({
+         yearMonth: yearMonthStr,
+         yearText: yearText,
+         monthText: monthText
+       });
+     },
+ 
+     // 生成月份天数数据
+     generateMonthDays(year, month) {
+       const days = [];
+       const today = new Date();
+       const todayYear = today.getFullYear();
+       const todayMonth = today.getMonth();
+       const todayDate = today.getDate();
+       const todayTimestamp = today.getTime();
+ 
+       // 获取当月的第一天和最后一天
+       const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1);
+       const lastDay = new Date(year, month + 1, 0);
+       
+       // 添加上月日期
+       this.addPrevMonthDays(days, firstDay, todayYear, todayMonth, todayDate, todayTimestamp);
+       
+       // 添加当月日期
+       this.addCurrentMonthDays(days, year, month, lastDay.getDate(), todayYear, todayMonth, todayDate, todayTimestamp);
+       
+       // 添加下月日期
+       this.addNextMonthDays(days, year, month, todayYear, todayMonth, todayDate, todayTimestamp);
+       
+       return days;
+     },
+ 
+     // 添加上月日期
+     addPrevMonthDays(days, firstDay, todayYear, todayMonth, todayDate, todayTimestamp) {
+       const prevMonth = firstDay.getMonth() === 0 ? 11 : firstDay.getMonth() - 1;
+       const prevYear = firstDay.getMonth() === 0 ? firstDay.getFullYear() - 1 : firstDay.getFullYear();
+       const prevMonthLastDay = new Date(firstDay.getFullYear(), firstDay.getMonth(), 0).getDate();
+       const firstDayOfWeek = firstDay.getDay() || 7;
+       const daysFromPrevMonth = firstDayOfWeek - 1;
+ 
+       for (let i = prevMonthLastDay - daysFromPrevMonth + 1; i <= prevMonthLastDay; i++) {
+         const date = `${prevYear}-${String(prevMonth + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}`;
+         const dateTimestamp = new Date(prevYear, prevMonth, i).getTime();
+         
+         days.push({
+           day: i,
+           date,
+           currentMonth: false,
+           isToday: (prevYear === todayYear && prevMonth === todayMonth && i === todayDate),
+           isPast: dateTimestamp < todayTimestamp
+         });
+       }
+     },
+ 
+     // 添加当月日期
+     addCurrentMonthDays(days, year, month, daysInMonth, todayYear, todayMonth, todayDate, todayTimestamp) {
+       for (let i = 1; i <= daysInMonth; i++) {
+         const date = `${year}-${String(month + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}`;
+         const dateTimestamp = new Date(year, month, i).getTime();
+         
+         days.push({
+           day: i,
+           date,
+           currentMonth: true,
+           isToday: (year === todayYear && month === todayMonth && i === todayDate),
+           isPast: dateTimestamp < todayTimestamp
+         });
+       }
+     },
+ 
+     // 添加下月日期
+     addNextMonthDays(days, year, month, todayYear, todayMonth, todayDate, todayTimestamp) {
+       const totalDaysSoFar = days.length;
+       const rowsNeeded = Math.ceil(totalDaysSoFar / 7);
+       const totalCells = rowsNeeded * 7;
+       const nextMonthDays = totalCells - totalDaysSoFar;
+       
+       if (nextMonthDays <= 0) return;
+       
+       const nextMonth = month === 11 ? 0 : month + 1;
+       const nextYear = month === 11 ? year + 1 : year;
+       
+       for (let i = 1; i <= nextMonthDays; i++) {
+         const date = `${nextYear}-${String(nextMonth + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}`;
+         const dateTimestamp = new Date(nextYear, nextMonth, i).getTime();
+         
+         days.push({
+           day: i,
+           date,
+           currentMonth: false,
+           isToday: (nextYear === todayYear && nextMonth === todayMonth && i === todayDate),
+           isPast: dateTimestamp < todayTimestamp
+         });
+       }
+     }
+   }
+ });
